mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting (particularly potassium and magnesium), while doxycycline may accumulate with renal impairment, increasing toxicity risk and photosensitivity complications.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and doxycycline levels closely; ensure adequate hydration during amphotericin B therapy; consider alternative antibiotics if severe renal dysfunction develops.
